title: hackathon packing list
caption:
48 hours. packed and ready. mostly.

laptop, charger, backup charger. a pitch with "AI" in it.
six energy drinks. checked.
sleep, a working demo, the idea itself: we'll figure it out.

what's the one thing you always forget at a hackathon?

slide.kicker: we'll win “most creative.” that means we lost.
